88626.title: Desktop shows four KPI tiles in a row and two count tiles below
88626.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1280 pixels wide (e.g. a 1920 x 1080 monitor).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
88626.custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Look at the arrangement of the tiles without scrolling sideways.
88626.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The first row holds four tiles side by side, left to right: Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization.
  • The second row, below it, holds two tiles side by side: Sales by Customer, At Risk Customers.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 12. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) board 01_Opens_After (1920 wide), used for on-screen labels only.
